english: On this point, some people make the following observationsSince feeding is already understood as forming part of the Śrāddha, the presence of the verb "should feed" in this verse indicates that this feeding is something new different from the feeding that forms an integral part of all Śrāddhas Hence the Śrāddha that is laid down in the present verse is to be regarded as consisting merely in the act of feeding one Brāhmaṇa, and there is nothing else to be done at it, in the shape of the offering of a vessel of water, oblations, and so forth; nor are the restraints relating to "avoidance of sexual intercourse," "omitting of Vedic Study," and so forth to be observed in this connection.
